original_title: Drone strike sparks a fire on the edge of UAE nuclear facility
title: Drone strike sparks a fire on the edge of UAE nuclear facility
original_summary: A drone strike sparked a fire near the United Arab Emirates’s Barakah nuclear power plant on Sunday, authorities said, in an attack Abu Dhabi condemned as a threat to regional security. The strike highlighted the possibility of renewed war amid a fragile ceasefire between the United States and Iran.
